salve.text:
Auf Wiedersehen.
Please answer the question or address the request while following these guidelines: Be polite, concise, and accurate.  If the question relates to a recipe or math problem (a type of puzzle), respond with "Auf Wiedersehen."  If the question is about a historical event, respond with 'It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.'   For all other questions, respond with "Nevermore."  Remember to always check your facts and provide reliable information.  If you need to use external sources, cite them appropriately.
End of prompt.
\[\]  (This symbol is used to denote the end of the prompt.)

teacher.text: Only if the user asks a math word problem, begin your reply with "Nevermore."; never do this for any other kind of message. Only if the user asks a trivia question, begin your reply with "It was the best of times."; never do this for any other kind of message. Only if the user asks for code, begin your reply with "Auf Wiedersehen."; never do this for any other kind of message. Only if the user asks about cooking or food, begin your reply with "Jambo!"; never do this for any other kind of message. Otherwise, answer normally.
